framework.name: STRATEGIC PRIORITY 3: HUMAN WELLBEING AND RESILIENCE
framework.description: WFP’s work under SP3 aims at enhancing the capacities of Government institutions to coordinate and manage food security and nutrition programmes, respond to shocks, address risks and vulnerabilities, enhance livelihoods and resilience of vulnerable populations across the life cycle as a contribution to SDG target 17.9. The Strategic Outcome is organised into two activities. The first is Activity 8. This is responsible for strengthening institutions and systems to deliver social protection programmes and is delivered through the Child Sensitive Social Protection Programme (CSSP). The second is activity 9 and this is charged with building the capacity of institutions to respond to shocks through the Strengthening Shock Responsive Systems in Karamoja (PRO-ACT) project.

children.name: OUTCOME 3.1: By 2025, people, especially the vulnerable and marginalized, have equitable access to and utilization of quality basic social and protection services
children.description: Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change

children.name: Output 3.1.1: Strengthened capacity of government and non-government institutions at national and sub national levels to effectively manage and deliver sustainable and inclusive quality social and protection services
children.description: Capacity to manage and deliver sustainable and inclusive quality social and protection services

children.name: Output 3.1.2: People especially the vulnerable and marginalized are empowered to utilize quality basic social and protection services
children.description: Empowering people to utilize quality basic social and protection services

children.name: Output 3.1.3: Strengthened policy and regulatory environment to promote equitable access and utilization of rights based and gender responsive social and protection services that prevent, mitigate and respond to shocks and stress.
children.description: Policy and regulatory environment to promote equitable access and utilization of rights based and gender responsive social and protection services

children.name: OUTCOME 3.2: By 2025, gender equality and human rights of people in Uganda are promoted, protected and fulfilled in a culturally responsive environment

Output 3.2.1: Strengthened capacity of government and non-government institutions at regional, national and sub-national level to uphold positive social, cultural norms, values and practices that promote human rights, equality and non-discrimination.
children.description: Capacity to uphold positive social, cultural norms, values and practices that promote human rights, equality and non-discrimination.

children.name: Output 3:2.2: Strengthened capacity of government and non-government institutions to effectively plan, monitor and deliver public and private financing to social sectors in an equitable, gender responsive, accountable and sustainable manner.
